question.text: If Class A1 has 1.5% management fee while other classes have 2%, the class with LOWER management fee will generally have:

answer.text: Higher Series NAV per unit (all else equal)

explanation.text: The Logic: Lower fees = higher net assets attributable to that class = higher Series NAV per unit (example Class A1 = Rs. 1253.13 vs. others at Rs. 1245.51 in Example 6). The Trap: Lower/same/negative NAV contradicts the arithmetic. Cross-Exam Context: Directly from Example 6 in the workbook.
